summary: M.S. Computer Engineering candidate at Rochester Institute of Technology (May 2026) who builds real-time embedded pipelines end-to-end: YOLOv8 on Jetson over UART to STM32, FreeRTOS task coordination, ToF contact detection, and ROS2 manipulation on a physical UR5e. Strong in bare-metal C firmware, sensor-to-control integration, and deploying perception into safety-constrained hardware.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi Pico and Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands; resolved sensor jitter via z-axis differential thresholding and software calibration.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a metal surface inspection pipeline using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation; achieved PSNR 86 and ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system (Flutter → Flask-SocketIO → Jetson+STM32 over WebSocket); 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS; dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via TCA9548A I2C mux for contact-aware grasping; two-link IK in C++ driving five servos with FreeRTOS mutex coordination; resolved 11 integration failures to reach production reliability.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson with real-time UART commands to STM32 for multi-servo tracking; interrupt-driven command handling with FreeRTOS mutex-protected shared memory and VL53L0X ToF distance feedback.
Implemented bare-metal C PWM control with user override; OLED visualization at deterministic update rate.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) on auto-generated semantic segmentation frames; integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and collision-free waypoint fallback.
Validated in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians — zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (UR5e)
bullets: Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place on a physical UR5e via ROS 2 Humble and MoveIt; derived full DH kinematic chain (0T6), validated against RViz URDF; AL5B repeatability <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 firmware in bare-metal C: timer-triggered ADC scan, interrupt-driven capture, low-level I2C driver; 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz — verified in Proteus.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
